issue.description:
AGENTS.md's compatibility boundary states bead-rs must never write another implementation's live SQLite database, but the documented field failure mode is silent corruption: a store written by a different bead tool surfaces only a generic SQLite 'no such column' error, or worse, appears to work and reinitializes the schema — the exact mechanism that nearly destroyed the SEAM workspace on 2026-08-14. Add a schema-identity marker (format UUID/version stamped at init) verified on every open, and when the database lacks it or carries a foreign shape, refuse every read and mutating subcommand with a structured error naming the mismatch and pointing at the correct tool — before any migration, probe, or repair runs. Tests: a foreign-shaped .beads/beads.db fixture must produce the structured refusal on all subcommands with zero bytes written, and bead doctor must diagnose (not open) it. Coordinate with the pending-migrations beads (beadrs-2c4e9030, beadrs-5c27b273) so a native old-schema store is migrated, not refused.
